plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for OneAccess router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 13191).
name: Router

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the OneAccess router since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the OneAccess router (ONEACCESS-SYS-MIB oacSysCpuUsed) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate forwarding or control-plane load.

metrics.name: device_cpu_core_usage
metrics.description: Current per-core CPU utilization of the OneAccess router (ONEACCESS-SYS-MIB oacSysCpuUsedValue). Core 0 is equivalent to oacSysCpuUsed.

metrics.name: device_cpu_core_usage_1min
metrics.description: One-minute per-core CPU utilization of the OneAccess router (ONEACCESS-SYS-MIB oacSysCpuUsedOneMinuteValue).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the OneAccess router (ONEACCESS-SYS-MIB oacSysMemoryUsed) reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. High memory pressure can degrade forwarding and control-plane stability.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total system memory of the OneAccess router in bytes (ONEACCESS-SYS-MIB oacSysMemoryTotal).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free system memory of the OneAccess router in bytes (ONEACCESS-SYS-MIB oacSysMemoryFree).

metrics.name: device_memory_allocated
metrics.description: Allocated system memory of the OneAccess router in bytes (ONEACCESS-SYS-MIB oacSysMemoryAllocated).
